summary: 2U air-cooled ProLiant Compute DL384 Gen12 with one or two NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper superchips.

value.superchipsPerServer: One GH200, or two for GH200 NVL2

value.coherentPerGh200: Up to 480 GB LPDDR5X plus 144 GB HBM3e
value.note: QuickSpecs note: 96 GB GH200 HBM is available to select customers. With-sparsity tensor figures are marked with an asterisk in the QuickSpecs and are not copied here.

value.boot: HW RAID is not supported this generation for M.2 or EDSFF NVMe

value.expansion: Up to four PCIe Gen5 x16 FHHL, or up to two FHHL plus two OCP 3.0
value.fabrics: NVIDIA InfiniBand, Ethernet, and BlueField adapters are stated as supported. Option SKUs were not extracted.

value.psu: Up to 4 HPE 1800W-2200W Flex Slot Titanium hot-plug supplies
value.singleGh200: 2+0, 2+1, or 2+2 redundancy, minimum of two power supplies
value.note: PSU kit ratings are not a system planning wattage.

value.warranty: 3/3/3 parts, labor, and onsite from date of purchase on the regional specifications page

support.note: The warranty statement is not an end-of-support date.

firmwareBaseline.reason: No firmware or driver version is included. Supported OS text says RHEL 9 (9.2+) at launch, with SLES and Ubuntu to follow; that is not a driver baseline.

components.description: NVIDIA GH200, 72 Arm cores, 480 GB LPDDR5X, 144 GB HBM3e

referenceConfigurations.title: Dual NVIDIA GH200 NVL2

components.description: GH200 NVL2, 144 Arm cores, 960 GB LPDDR5X, 288 GB HBM3e

referenceConfigurations.note: QuickSpecs configuration tables also label some factory-integrated kits with Gen11 part descriptions. The document title is DL384 Gen12.
